apps.title: Games & apps
apps.setup.title: Set up for a game
apps.rec.udp: Record voice chat and game servers (UDP)
apps.rec.udp_hint: Requires the WinDivert driver. Anti-cheat games may detect it; leave it off if unsure.
apps.rec.udp_more: The driver is needed only while recording. Unchecked: TCP only. If optimization is on, the driver is already running.
apps.profiles.title: App profiles
apps.debug.title: Connection debugging
apps.debug.hint: Record where the app connects, keep what you need and save the profile. Recording changes nothing and stops by itself after 5 minutes.
apps.debug.no_driver_tip: UDP cannot be recorded without the driver: Windows does not keep remote UDP addresses.
apps.debug.no_driver_hint: In return, anti-cheat games will not see the driver. On by default.
apps.debug.recorded.title: Recorded connections
apps.debug.denoise_tip: Select as the app would: without Windows services, browsers, local network and old background traffic
apps.game.title: Game mode
apps.game.warn: Latency (ping) in games and CPU load may increase, especially with torrents.
apps.more_tools: More: IP lists and custom subnets
apps.ipset.title: IP lists
apps.ipset.mode_caption: Address-based site optimization (“Off” also turns off game mode)
apps.ipset.try_any_tip: For 10 minutes, for any connection; sites may work with errors meanwhile
apps.ipset.any_warn: Optimization is running for any connection; many sites may work with errors.
apps.subnets.title: Custom subnets
apps.intro: Click “Start”, launch the game and get to the part that does not work (login, server, voice chat). Then click “Done”; settings are chosen for this game only.
apps.off_hint: Optimization is off. The profile will start working when you turn it on.
apps.rec.status: Recording. Launch the game and get to the part that does not work.
apps.rec.detail: Only programs launched after “Start”. Stops by itself after 5 minutes.
apps.rec.nothing_detail: Was the game launched after “Start”? System services, browsers and local network are ignored.
apps.err.apply_detail: Details are in the status bar below.
apps.check.applied: Applied: “{title}” — {summary}. Restart the game. Did it work?
apps.profile.saved_off: Profile “{title}” saved. It will work once you turn on optimization.

apps.giveup.one: Not found within {n} attempt. Everything restored.
apps.giveup.other: Not found within {n} attempts. Everything restored.

apps.giveup_detail: “Connection debugging” opens the recorded connections so you can select the needed ones manually.
apps.rec.interrupted: Recording interrupted: the helper restarted. Start again.
apps.rec.expired: Recording stopped at the time limit (5 minutes). Click “Done”; what was recorded is kept.
apps.err.pick_process: Select a process from the list or record “everything started after”.
apps.debug.too_many: Too many connections; some were not recorded.
apps.debug.preview_empty: Select the game's connections: at least one external address and port are required.
apps.ipset.file.title: IP list
apps.ipset.any_text: All addresses for 10 minutes (check): {time} left, then “{mode}” returns.
apps.ipset.try_any_question: For 10 minutes optimization will run for any connection, which shows whether it helps at all. Many sites may work with errors meanwhile; then everything returns by itself. Turn on?
apps.ipset.game_off: Game mode is off: it does not work without an IP list.
apps.ipset.any_started: Check on all addresses is on for 10 minutes; then the mode returns.
apps.ipset.any_ended: Check on all addresses is over; mode “{mode}” is back.
apps.ipset.list_info: Subnets: {lines}, updated {date}, covers {share}% of internet addresses
apps.ipset.file_big: The file is too large for an IP list.
apps.busy.check_file: Checking the list from the file…
apps.ipset.not_applied: The new list was not applied; the previous one is kept.
apps.ipset.kept: The previous IP list is kept.
apps.subnets.hint_active: One subnet per line, for example 203.0.113.0/24, or a single address. Take effect right after “Save”.
apps.subnets.hint_inactive: One subnet per line, for example 203.0.113.0/24, or a single address. Apply in “Lists only” mode.
apps.subnets.enable_question: Custom subnets apply only in “Lists only” mode. Turn it on?
apps.game.status.off_blocked: Off. Cannot be turned on while the check on all addresses is running.
apps.game.status.paused: Paused: check on all addresses is running (in “More”). Resumes by itself after it.
apps.game.status.running: Works from the address list below ↓
apps.game.status.running_n: Works from the address list below ↓ (subnets: {lines})
apps.game.status.pending: Turns on with optimization, from the address list below ↓
apps.game.status.pending_n: Turns on with optimization, from the address list below ↓ (subnets: {lines})
apps.anticheat: Anti-cheat games (Vanguard, FACEIT, Easy Anti-Cheat) may not work while the optimization driver (WinDivert) is loaded.
apps.game.hint: If a game or app works worse, turn this off.
apps.core.note.no_udp: UDP was not recorded; the profile is TCP only.
apps.core.note.too_many_addr: More than {max} addresses; kept {max}. The game seems to connect directly between players.
apps.core.note.udp_no_driver: UDP is not recorded: without the driver Windows does not show where UDP goes. Only TCP connections were recorded.
